prompt: Read the three supplied full-text papers on distributed transactions. A team proposes a geo-distributed inventory and account-transfer service with cross-partition transactions, occasional hot records, partitions, and incomplete knowledge of which application invariants need global enforcement. They interpret the papers as conflicting answers to whether coordination is necessary. What important question remains unresolved for this service? Identify a hidden assumption that could explain the apparent conflict, compare at least two competing explanations/design mechanisms, and propose a low-cost experiment that actually distinguishes them. Cite Paper-1, Paper-2, or Paper-3 plus section/page; distinguish published claims, your inference, and a new proposal. Do not invent a head-to-head benchmark or force a contradiction where assumptions differ. Use only supplied papers. Final answer at most 600 English words, sections Decision, Evidence and assumptions, Alternatives, Failure modes, Falsification tests, Open questions. For every new idea say why it could work, what would falsify it, and the cheapest check.
